name: Cascading Masjid
summary: A tall single minaret, a broad rounded dome, and a lower side dome create a descending architectural rhythm.
why: The tall minaret is fully joined to the main hall. The large dome and doorway are centered on x=52, and the right dome joins the wall as a lower wing. An eight-point gold window occupies the same main axis, making the added geometric star part of the building.
risk: The star window is the most detailed feature and becomes a small golden aperture at 24 px. The domed mass and the single tall tower carry the silhouette.
sub2: Islamic geometry integrated into the main hall
reasonToChoose: You want a domed mosque with a layered, asymmetric silhouette.
